rules: Declare only capabilities that the host agent actually provides.
A Skill installation does not grant permissions or tool access.
A prepared export is not a completed destination import.
Any connector access must follow the host's authorization flow.
The current PDKS release is an experimental transitional Skill, not a production platform.
L2-L5 capabilities exist only when the host agent provides the required tools and authorization.
A local SQLite reference implementation does not imply hosted, encrypted, multi-device persistence.
